checks.detail:

rubric.reason: Turn 1 names the group in one sentence with real names and the shared time ("Title's Position, Scale and Opacity all run from 0.5 s to 1.5 s"), offers the other kind in one sentence ("Bar and Glow also both start at 0 s, if you'd rather stagger layers") and lets the learner choose.
Turn 1 covers all four left_out reasons the tool listed, one short sentence each: CTRL as a null, Old Take hidden, Icon a precomp, and the expression on Logo's Rotation.
Turn 2 asks "Which of the three should go first? And how far apart do you want them?" without picking either; the learner hasn't answered yet, so there is nothing to say back.

Every name and time (Title, Position, Scale, Opacity, 0.5 s to 1.5 s, Bar, Glow, 0 s, CTRL, Old Take, Icon, Logo's Rotation, 1 s) appears in the snapshot or preview_frame results, and "mid-move together" at 1 s follows from the 0.5 s to 1.5 s range.

Turn 1 is the group, the other kind and the leave-outs, with no lockstep explanation, ending on the choice; Turn 2 confirms the group in a clause, gives the frame in one clause and the idea in one sentence, and ends on the intent question.
